notes.title: Watamari - A Match Made in Heaven Part1 - Kemomimi Patch Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42865517/e036973cc40c240b91ee7d2ce61e6a06275fbfe8.png[/img]

The Kemonomimi Patch for Watamari just released on Steam! What does "Kemonomimi" mean exactly? It just adds animal ears to the character sprites and CGs! What a fun way to enhance the Watamari reading experience. You must own the base game on Steam to purchase and install this DLC. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2062210/Watamari__A_Match_Made_in_Heaven_Part1/
